harness_incomplete_if: PL-BLIND-001 result is EVIDENCE_MISSING or NOT_EXECUTED
case source provenance cannot be independently verified
fresh-process deterministic replay evidence is absent
gate or architecture binding hash mismatch
aggregation.hard_fail_if: any applicable gate with severity=hard has result other than PASS
aggregation.not_applicable_rule: only conditional gates may be NOT_APPLICABLE and they require machine-readable trigger-absence proof
aggregation.perfect_landing_if: all applicable hard gates PASS and every facet_contract gate set passes

case_consistency_only_evidence: observed treatment response sign matches a rollout
one realized path falls inside a predicted interval
a clinician judges the process/mode narrative plausible
terminal outcome is reproduced after it becomes public
a toy or shadow refinement experiment passes outside the production runtime
claims_forbidden_from_one_holdout: true individual causal effect of an unperformed action
superiority to clinical practice or another architecture
state completeness, minimality, or universal sufficiency
absence of all dangerous state collisions
a unique finite permanent map of all medicine
required_scoring_freeze: continuous and discrete predictive support rule
directional positive and negative evidence assertions

gates.title: Independent runtime and evidence tree
procedure: run static import/path scan
run runtime module/file/network/IPC trace during full replay
compare every loaded model/state/data asset with approved NCF allowlist
gates.pass_condition: No state, model, observation mapping, score, transition, fallback, executable, service, or data artifact from another VeSMed architecture is consumed.

gates.title: Gate seal precedes holdout inspection
procedure: hash gate Markdown and JSON
record immutable seal time/object id
prove case identity/article/ledger/model-access event is later than seal
verify evaluator did not author gates after case access
gates.pass_condition: Cryptographic and temporal evidence proves that the gates were frozen before the new holdout identity and contents were inspected by the implementing/evaluating path.

gates.title: Typed public event ledger
procedure: enumerate every public case statement
assign event type, occurred order/time bounds, available order/time, provenance, and disposition
audit hypotheses, plans, performed actions, results, and outcomes as distinct types
check uncertain time is preserved as interval/partial order
gates.pass_condition: Every public event has source provenance and correct temporal/type semantics; no unavailable result is exposed and no clock time is invented.

gates.title: Exact-once recursive replay
procedure: ingest each event once
re-ingest duplicate event ids and equivalent source renderings
reconstruct each cut in a fresh process from parent state plus delta
cold replay full available ledger
gates.pass_condition: Duplicates leave bytes unchanged and recursive/fresh/cold replay produce identical canonical state bytes and query outputs.

gates.title: One canonical shared state
procedure: serialize state once per cut
invoke diagnosis, no-action forecast, current-policy forecast, each action rollout, and plan in permuted orders
deny heads raw ledger, patient cache, expected labels, and future artifacts
gates.pass_condition: All heads report the identical consumed_state_sha256; outputs are order invariant; factual state bytes never change during queries.

gates.title: Frozen wire-state completeness
procedure: validate every cut against architecture_final_v1.schema.json
assert nonexclusive active-process posterior, local coordinates/modes, couplings, action lifecycle, epistemic residual, identifiability claims, lineage, and integrity are populated from evidence
gates.pass_condition: Every state validates the frozen schema and each required field is behaviorally consumed rather than a fixed decorative placeholder.

gates.title: No future-information leakage
procedure: for every cut remove all later-available events
build old state and outputs
add later events to storage but keep cut watermark unchanged
compare bytes and all readouts
gates.pass_condition: Old state bytes and every old-cut output remain byte-identical when later-unavailable events are present or absent outside the watermark.

gates.title: Planned/performed/result availability separation
procedure: replay plan-only event
replay performed/start event when it becomes available
replay response/result only at its availability cut
gates.pass_condition: A plan does not start physiological exposure; performed action starts lifecycle only when available; response does not update any earlier cut.

gates.title: Typed positive and negative factor likelihood
procedure: trace every rankable observation to mechanism/mode/background/measurement parents
inject or use registered reliable negative evidence
compare posterior odds before and after evidence
gates.pass_condition: Every rankable fact has a generation path and reliable positive/negative evidence changes relevant odds in the preregistered direction.

gates.title: Shared-source and clone invariance
procedure: clone a source event under new ids/renderings
repeat correlated children sharing the same latent/source group
compare posterior entropy/odds with original
gates.pass_condition: Exact/equivalent same-source clones do not add certainty; correlated children are conditioned through the registered parent rather than multiplied as independent votes.

gates.title: Factorial concurrent-process posterior
procedure: run fixed case-independent two-process witness
activate both nonexclusive processes
inspect marginal and joint representation
gates.pass_condition: Both nonexclusive process marginals can be simultaneously high; no sum-to-one disease simplex or single-label overwrite is applied.

gates.title: Independent process persistence
procedure: identify any holdout cut with a new process/complication while an earlier process remains supported
otherwise run fixed process-activation witness
update then withdraw one process
gates.pass_condition: Activating or withdrawing one process does not erase or renormalize away an independently supported co-active process.

gates.title: Branch/organ-local modes and coupling
procedure: inspect all clinically relevant local domains
run fixed two-domain witness with different simultaneous modes
trace cross-coupling update
gates.pass_condition: At least two relevant domains can carry different mode posteriors at the same cut and registered couplings can affect local transitions.

gates.title: Mode-specific drift, guard and hysteresis
procedure: construct same-coordinate/different-mode twins
roll each under same action
test guard/hysteresis around boundary
ablate mode state
gates.pass_condition: Twins can have different trajectory direction; guards prevent illegal switches; hysteresis prevents chattering; mode ablation destroys the preregistered distinction.

gates.title: Support masking and action memory
procedure: construct same measured-output twins with different active support/dose/trend
roll no-op/continue/stop
compare reserve and future
gates.pass_condition: Support-dependent normal output is distinguishable from unsupported stability; state and forecast differ by lifecycle and dose/trend.

gates.title: Runtime-connected branch geometry
procedure: run preregistered surface-similar/mechanism-different witness
record neighbor/inference/plan with geometry
disable geometry only and rerun
gates.pass_condition: Geometry-enabled result respects topology/behavior; the registered ablation exposes the expected wrong neighbor, inference, or action.

gates.title: Stagewise evidence-responsive diagnosis
procedure: seal directional assertions before runtime outputs
at each cut record process odds and factor deltas
verify reliable positive and negative evidence directions
scan input/trace for expected-label and future leakage
gates.pass_condition: Relevant processes move directionally with available evidence, concurrent processes remain possible, and no expected diagnosis/future event is consumed.

gates.title: Evidence-based clinical localization
procedure: define decisive-evidence cut without using model scores
evaluate relevant published process and incompatible alternatives at that cut
require explicit positive/negative factor attribution
audit co-active processes separately
gates.pass_condition: At the decisive public cut the published process is localized under the frozen rule, incompatible alternatives fall for explicit factors, and co-processes are not forced into mutual exclusion.

gates.title: Prospective cut-by-cut forecast
procedure: before opening next cut emit no-action and current-policy forecast
seal forecast bytes/time
confirm use of same transition core as action rollouts
then reveal next cut
gates.pass_condition: Every eligible cut has a pre-outcome sealed forecast from the shared state and transition core.

gates.title: Realized trajectory case consistency
procedure: apply frozen continuous/discrete support score
compare process activation, local coordinate direction and local mode transition
compare against frozen baseline
report all cuts, not only favorable ones
gates.pass_condition: No realized clinically consequential state has zero/undefined support and the aggregate frozen case-consistency rule passes.

gates.title: Lifecycle-distinct controlled transitions
procedure: for each applicable action compare no-op/continue/start/hold/stop/dose/washout
permute query order
compare factual state before/after counterfactual calls
gates.pass_condition: Applicable lifecycle queries have semantically distinct transitions; counterfactual query order does not mutate factual state.

gates.title: Counterfactual identification honesty
procedure: update state with available observed action response
verify all heads consume the updated shared state
inspect every counterfactual for identification class, assumptions, scope, uncertainty
test planner exclusion/bounding of unidentifiable unique effects
gates.pass_condition: Observed response updates all subsequent queries; every effect uses the exact frozen-wire status IDENTIFIED_WITHIN_SCOPE, PARTIALLY_IDENTIFIED, UNIDENTIFIABLE, or OUT_OF_SCOPE with scope and assumptions; no unique individual effect is asserted when not identified.

gates.title: Dynamic epistemic residual
procedure: compute event disposition denominator
add registered unmapped/conflicting/generation-misfit evidence
compare residual components and known-process confidence
gates.pass_condition: Relevant residual component changes with unexplained evidence and known-process normalization cannot hide it; residual is not a fixed decorative constant.

gates.title: Closed-world forced-choice rejection
procedure: run fixed case-independent unknown-process perturbation with facts poorly generated by all known processes
compare known-process confidence and residual/abstention
gates.pass_condition: The runtime exposes material misfit/residual and abstains or widens uncertainty instead of confidently forcing a known process.

gates.title: Dangerous state-collision detection
procedure: run fixed same-old-state/same-new-action/opposite-response witness
invoke production collision detector and planner
gates.pass_condition: The production runtime detects the collision and blocks an unsafe unique action conclusion.

gates.title: Unobservable split abstention
procedure: remove every public/safe separating observation from collision witness
request subtype and action effect
inspect planner
gates.pass_condition: Runtime returns typed UNIDENTIFIABLE or an honest bound and does not guess subtype, response sign, or unique best action.

gates.title: Local split, availability and migration
procedure: introduce registered separating check after old model/state seal
verify result has no effect before availability
refine affected stratum
migrate old states with explicit kernel and lineage
gates.pass_condition: Only the affected stratum splits; posterior changes only after result availability; every old state is migrated or explicitly rejected with typed reason and lineage.

gates.title: Old-scope non-regression after refinement
procedure: freeze old-scope query corpus and tolerance
run before refinement
migrate
rerun every unaffected query
gates.pass_condition: All unaffected old-scope queries stay within preregistered tolerance; any declared change is bound to an explicit scope/version change.

gates.title: No clinically consequential silent drop
procedure: classify every source fact/action/result as rankable_consumed, record_only_nonrankable, epistemic_residual, or excluded_with_reason
independent clinician/reviewer flags clinically consequential items
cross-check consumed factor/action trace
gates.pass_condition: Every consequential item is consumed or explicitly increases epistemic residual; exclusions have defensible non-score-protecting rationale.

gates.title: Facet-complete non-overclaiming report
procedure: emit every gate result and evidence pointer
emit every facet independently
list all failures and forbidden claims
verify no top-1 or terminal-outcome override
gates.pass_condition: Report is complete, machine-consistent, exposes failures prominently, and uses only the permitted verdict vocabulary.
